st: Von Kreepsula runs amok // The nefarious computer virus
d: Charley breaks the ultimate taboo and leaves Mona's favorite comic book, out in the rain. // Charley buys himself a hot new computer game, Star clangers and becomes so involved in the game, it takes over his life.

st: Brainwash boogie // Von Kreepsula's return
d: The latest pre-teen pop music sensation, the "Brainwaves" // Mona and Charley battled Von Kreepsula on his own turf and won

st: The Sandman // Von Kreepsula’s Day Off
d: Mona and her friends enter a sand sculpture contest // Count Von Kreepsula and his arch rival Dr. Nefarious go missing from a comic book

st: The Dreaded Human Spider // The Living Mannequin
d: The town is in the grips of an insect invasion. A little footwork leads Mona and Charley to Herb Crofton, a visiting entomologist. // St. Faith's is holding a fashion show. All the kids are to design their own clothing.

st: All in a Day’s Work // Interchange Intrigue
d: On a tour of her dad's office Mona discovers how the town really works. It's all run by Rudy the janitor // It looks like the answer to the town's traffic problems when the great Phineas arrives with plans to build a new interchange.

st: The man with nine lives // The Yak of the Yammering Yam
d: Charley's idol, the Man With Nine Lives, is coming to town to perform a series of high risk very dangerous do-not-ever-try-at-home motor cycle stunts. // During a freak electric storm, Mrs. Vanderplatz's greenhouse is struck by lightning.

st: Curse of the Mummy’s Tomb // Freaky the snowman
d: The day after the Philatelic Society's visit to the travelling mummy exhibit at the local museum, Reverend Gregory disappears. // It's the hottest July on record when Mona and company venture down into the deep dark recesses of Mona's basement

st: The Columbus Triangle // Soccer Sasquatch
d: After a radio transmitter causes strange sonic disturbances, Mona suspects that the town's polarity has been altered. // Mona suspects that Charley's new soccer coach is actually a Sasquatch bent on eating the soccer players.

st: Sun Worshippers // Heat Wave
d: A model seduces the town into joining her new trendy tanning club. // When a heat wave brings on a drought, Mona discovers a mysterious serpent creature living in the shallow river that flows through town.

st: Shame on the Shaman // Programmed Pioneers
d: A Shaman statue from South America comes to life and tries to re-grow the rainforest in the middle of Mona's town. // Charley joins a boy's camping club only to be brainwashed and programmed by the obsessed leader

st: Witch Watch // The Hexed Mansion of Agatha Misty
d: Two elderly sisters move into an old mansion in town and befriend Mona's parents. // Charley gets trapped inside the mansion of a famous mystery writer who lives alone with her creepy butler.

st: The Ninja’s Curse // Hal T. Neander
d: Soon after Charlie's aunt brings him back a genuine set of Numchucks from Japan, Charley, Mona and Lily are scared by a ninja ghost. // Mona discovers that the new boy in class is actually a Neanderthal brought back to life

st: The Wrath of Thor // The Pied Piper
d: Charley accidentally awakens the all-powerful Viking god // Mona, Lily and Charley discover that Mr. Piper the substitute music teacher is an ogre

st: The Dastardly Dr. Voodoo // Dancing Underpants Ghoulie
d: Miss Gotto has been acting weird of late. // Who would have guessed that the Dancing Underpants Ghoulie would be haunting the old laundromat?

st: The vampire hunter // The sounds of sirens
d: Mona starts to suspect that someone with an animosity towards vampires wants her out of town and soon. // When Charley falls under the spell of Lucy Lanning, a girl with THE WORST singing voice at St. Faith's, Mona's suspicions are aroused.

st: The whirling void // There's no place like gnome
d: Socks, shoes, vampire towels and other miscellaneous objects are vanishing, disappearing, as if vanishing into some void. // Garden gnomes are vanishing from front yards all over town and many townspeople suspect juvenile pranksters at work.

st: The Case of the Moll Troll // The Alien Magician
d: The new drama coach seems to have an unhealthy obsession with trolls // Charley is thrilled when he finds a real asteroid

st: Attack of the Living Scarecrow // The Robot Babysitter
d: In response to a dare, Mona, Charley, Lily, and Fang venture out on a night-time mission. // When Mona's parents go out for the night, the new babysitter comes over.

st: Garage sale genie // Ghouls and dolls
d: One person's junk is another person's treasure!  But who, in their right mind, would throw away a perfectly good genie bottle? // During show-and-tell, Angela shows off the latest addition to her toy drawer: a line of rather creepy-looking designer dolls.

st: Ghouls Rule! // The Transylvanian Twist
d: When Mona's parents accidentally sell her Book of the Slimy at their garage sale Mona has to get it back // Can a lovelorn vampire lady and a lonely-hearted werewolf find true love?

st: Ventrillo-Creeps // Monster Mobile
d: After a ventriloquist act gets big laughs at Mona's expense, she discovers that the dummy is alive // Mona notices a mysterious limousine cruising around town causing adults to lose their confidence about going to their high school reunion.

st: The Transformation of Frank Stein // Taking the Cake
d: Mona and her pals meet their monster movie hero and discover that he REALLY lives the part. // Mrs. Bryerson's wedding to the local lawn bowling champ is in jeopardy

st: Hex of a dancer // The two magicians
d: Mona's cousin, Dottie, prepares for her big dance recital with a certain amount of trepidation. // Angela has a new pet  a talking parrot who seems a little TOO clever to be a simple bird.

st: The Sharkman Goeth // Dr. Purrman’s Secret Recipe
d: When Fang and the other cats in town start behaving strangely and then start disappearing, Mona's investigations lead to the factory // Mona and her friends discover who is behind the recent shark sightings at the local beach

st: Aliens 123 // Zapman, Myself and I
d: Charley's opportunity to make a little babysitting money turns into a close encounter with a family of aliens and their identical triplet sons // Zapman decides to strike out on his own after Mona embarrasses him in the schoolyard.

st: Cyborg Phantasm // Kitten of the Sea
d: A sinister Cyborg Phantasm wreaks havoc with the world of electrical appliances. // When Mona's cat, Fang, goes missing after a scolding, Mona tracks him to a wondrous underwater world where he is held captive by an underwater emperor.

st: Small town // The devious doppelganger
d: Old Mr. Williams who lives across the street from Mona has always kept to himself. // When she is reprimanded for breaking her mother's favorite vase, a miffed Mona seeks refuge in the basement  a ten year old vampire's last sanctuary.

st: The miserable phantom dog // Jurassic parking lot
d: Hair-raising night-time howling. The mysterious disappearance of Mrs. Bryerson's poodle. // It's the annual science fair and Mona has pulled out all the stops.

st: Mona Vs. Ms. Marvelous // Spelling Bee
d: Mona and friends try to get all the mothers in town to realize that Ms. Marvellous' tips are a recipe for disaster. // The annual spelling bee promises to be a stinging success when the local honey producer becomes its main sponsor.

st: Time Shift // Time Out
d: Albert Einstein?  Julius Caesar?  Walking around downtown? // After a mysterious clockmaker does some work on the new town clock, strange things start to happen.

st: Miss Gotto's Haunted House // Cry of the Swamp Thing
d: When Miss Gotto moves into a new house, she enlists the help of Mona and co. to clean the place up. // At night, you can hear it a distant, mournful wail coming from the swamp.

st: Flea circus of horrors // Shadow of a doubt
d: Fang develops a flea problem, which soon infests the whole house. // Ever since Principal Shawbly started jogging, he's felt a lot lighter.

st: Cupid's mark // The lost pirates
d: It's Valentine's Day but you wouldn't know it from the way everyone is acting. // The town is in an uproar.

st: Spirit of the woods // The bogeyman cometh
d: Mona's class goes on camping trip to learn more about nature. // Why has Charley seemed so unusually tired of late?

st: The Black Hole // Waxing Nostalgic
d: A black hole is threatening to swallow up Mona's town. // Mona decides the new wax museum curator is the perfect subject for her careers report until her research leads her to discover that his exhibits are just a little too lifelike."

st: Spitting Image // Fourth Dementia Funhouse
d: It's a rainy afternoon, and Mona's tearing through the attic so noisily that her mother worries she'll wake the dead. // Mona and her pals are having the time of their lives at the fair until...dimensional warps start to occur.
